mode: native WPF app driven with real OS keyboard input (keybd_event) from an in-process capture harness; screenshots via RenderTargetBitmap at 96 dpi

checks.check: Arrow Down moves the current cell down
Arrow Right moves the current cell right
Enter commits the edit and moves down one row
Escape cancels the edit and keeps the value
Tab out of an editing cell does not leave the next cell in edit mode
checks.evidence: after F2,Tab: column Unit, editing=False, focused=DataGridCell

checks.check: Invalid value (qty 0) marks the row and updates the status-bar error count
checks.evidence: row errors: Quantity must be greater than 0.; count 2→3

checks.check: Header stays visible while scrolled to the last row
checks.evidence: header top y 115.2→115.2, vertical offset 3, row 23

checks.check: Enter on the last row adds a new line and moves into it
Focus ring visible on the current cell after every keyboard move
checks.evidence: 17/17 snapshots show a 2 px Brush.Focus.Ring border on the focused cell

checks.check: Numeric columns right-aligned with tabular figures; text columns left
F6 cycles panes (filter → command bar → grid) and Ctrl+F focuses the filter
Reduced motion: no storyboards; only the indeterminate progress bar in the loading state (no OS reduced-motion query in WPF beyond SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation)

evidence.appAnimations: none except the indeterminate ProgressBar in the loading state; no storyboards

checks.check: Column priority: low-priority columns hide first as the window narrows; essentials stay

notes: First-render failures: Tab from an editing cell left the ComboBox column in edit mode (arrows then went to the editor); Shift+Down did not extend the selection (two causes: IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem re-syncing the selection on every CurrentCell move, and the harness sending numpad arrow keys without KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY so Windows injected a Shift release).
Harness caveat: the F2 test appends '12' after the formatted '800.00' (caret at end) producing 800.0012; this documents current caret behaviour rather than a target value.
Not verified: Narrator/NVDA, 150/200% DPI, high-contrast theme, mouse/context-menu paths, column-layout persistence (not implemented).
